overrides_reviewed: kubejs/server_scripts/example.js is the stock example (console.info only); kubejs/data, datapacks/ and moonlight-global-datapacks/ are empty.

Global loot modifiers in 9 jars: none changes the drop of a block broken by a plain turtle pickaxe. TConstruct's 'lustrous' and chrysophilite add ore entries only for a tool carrying that Tinkers modifier; Artifacts' pickaxe heater needs the artifact worn; the others touch chests, mobs, leaves, grass, fishing, flax or archaeology.
Quark's jar also carries a loot table for glass and stained glass (clear shards behind a config flag); those blocks are marked unhandled.
The instance is the CLIENT pack (packwiz); the server's mod set may differ.
